name: Edenbachalpe
kurzbeschreibung:
**Edenbachalpe in Grän** – Discover the breathtaking **Edenbachalpe** in **Grän**, a hidden gem nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps. This serene alpine meadow offers stunning panoramic views, crystal-clear streams, and a peaceful retreat for nature lovers.

Whether you're hiking along well-marked trails, enjoying a refreshing **Kaiserschmarrn** at a cozy alpine hut, or simply soaking in the tranquility of the mountains, the **Edenbachalpe** promises an unforgettable escape.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this idyllic spot is perfect for a day trip or an overnight stay in one of the charming nearby villages. Experience the magic of the Alps in all its glory!
